questions.prompt: Where do you declare that a pane should run Python instead of the default toolchain?
choices: Name the section file with a .py suffix so it runs as Python
Pass a --python flag to the binary
questions.explanation: Each pane has its own `toolchain` field; leave it empty to use course.json's `default_toolchain`, or let the runner infer it from the entry file's extension.

questions.prompt: What role does a section id play beyond identifying the URL?
choices: It decides the sidebar sort order
It is the learner's progress key
It selects the default display language
It names the binary at build time
questions.explanation: Progress is stored under `chNN/<section-id>` in SQLite — renaming an id loses the learner's progress, so never rename after shipping.

questions.prompt: How are bilingual content files organized?
choices: A single file holding both languages
Fully separate vi/ and en/ directories
One .vi.* / .en.* file pair per piece of content
The second language is machine-translated at runtime
questions.explanation: The `.<lang>.md` / `.<lang>.json` convention keeps pairs side by side; the server falls back through the locales listed in course.json.
